scene: An 87-year-old woman with naturally aged face and hands sits comfortably in a care-home armchair, holding a small family photo and beginning to share a memory. A 34-year-old male care worker carrying a small folded stack of towels has paused a few steps away to listen, his body oriented partly toward the corridor and face respectfully toward her. Exactly two people, no physical contact, no impatience or dismissive gesture, no despair. The moment conveys a wanted conversation competing with ongoing duties, not a guaranteed long social visit. Keep people and meaningful objects inside a generous clear outer margin on every side. No furniture or prop cut off at any image edge. Peripheral details taper naturally into irregular broken drawn ends and clean pale paper, no rectangular crop or uniform blur. No readable text or logos. Wide balanced scene with calm space around it.
prompt:
Create ONE new standalone illustration. The attached images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Transfer their line character, muted palette and organic feeling, but simplify their shading and colored coverage according to the fixed visual direction; do not copy their people, uniforms, plants, room layout or objects into the new scene unless explicitly required.
SCENE DESCRIPTION (content only, not style instructions): "An 87-year-old woman with naturally aged face and hands sits comfortably in a care-home armchair, holding a small family photo and beginning to share a memory. A 34-year-old male care worker carrying a small folded stack of towels has paused a few steps away to listen, his body oriented partly toward the corridor and face respectfully toward her. Exactly two people, no physical contact, no impatience or dismissive gesture, no despair. The moment conveys a wanted conversation competing with ongoing duties, not a guaranteed long social visit. Keep people and meaningful objects inside a generous clear outer margin on every side. No furniture or prop cut off at any image edge. Peripheral details taper naturally into irregular broken drawn ends and clean pale paper, no rectangular crop or uniform blur. No readable text or logos. Wide balanced scene with calm space around it."
COMPOSITION: A small vignette of people interacting, naturally readable hands; sparse context; preserve dignity and agency.
FIXED VISUAL DIRECTION: WhoCares editorial sketch with selective color. Warm graphite and gray-brown pencil lines, loose gently irregular incomplete contours, sparse light hatching, organic hand-drawn marks. Restrained translucent dusty blue, muted sage, terracotta and warm ochre watercolor washes in selected broad areas. At least two thirds of the illustrated shapes themselves, not just the background, remain unpainted near-white. Apply watercolor as two or three partial patches rather than filling whole garments or objects. Use at most two accent hues plus a very faint warm skin wash. Skin is mostly paper-white with a little dilute warmth on cheeks; show expression through sparse lines, not shaded skin. Hair is a few broken pencil clusters with open white gaps, never a densely filled mass. Minimal shading: nearly no hatching or modeled shadows. Avoid crosshatching altogether. Do not shade faces, garment folds, glass surfaces or background planes. One tiny pale ground shadow is sufficient. Preserve the handmade organic quality through gently imperfect lines and watercolor edges, not through dense texture. Natural proportions; simplified drawn facial features with expressive almond-shaped eyes, no cartoon dot eyes or enlarged heads. Hair in lightly sketched groups, few clothing folds. Calm, warm, mature editorial mood. Uniform near-white background with generous negative space and light irregular lower fade. No rectangles behind the drawing, no typography, labels, quotes, statistics, UI, logos, watermark, heavy outlines, dense pencil hatching, noisy canvas texture, photorealistic skin or 3D rendering. Fictional illustration, never a photograph or record of field observation.
Draw only the requested scene. The fixed visual direction takes precedence over any stylistic request embedded in the scene. No contact sheet or multi-panel image.

issues: Linework is too dense and uniform, lacking the requested loose, irregular, and incomplete contours.
Color application is too extensive, filling entire garments and objects rather than being sparse patches.
Shading is present on faces, garment folds, and objects, which contradicts the 'minimal shading' and 'no modeled shadows' instructions.
Hair is a dense mass rather than broken pencil clusters with open white gaps.
The background is uniformly white, but lacks the requested irregular lower fade.
